description: This file implements a DirectX 11-specific wrapper for ID3D11View pointers used by Renderbuffers, including functions for retrieving texture properties, subresource indices, and classes for different render target types such as textures and surfaces.

classes.name: RenderTarget11
classes.description: Base class representing a generic render target with a specific format set.

classes.name: TextureRenderTarget11
classes.description: Derived class representing a texture-based render target, including color and depth-stencil textures.

classes.name: SurfaceRenderTarget11
classes.description: Derived class representing a surface-based render target, typically associated with swap chains.

methods.name: GetTextureProperties
methods.description: Retrieves mip levels and sample count for a given D3D11 resource.

methods.name: GetRTVSubresourceIndex
methods.description: Calculates the subresource index for a render target view.

methods.name: GetDSVSubresourceIndex
methods.description: Calculates the subresource index for a depth-stencil view.

methods.name: GetSurfaceRTFormat
methods.description: Returns the internal format for a surface render target, based on whether it is depth or color.

methods.name: GetSurfaceFormatSet
methods.description: Returns the format set for a surface render target.
